content: संबन्ध {%a.%} Able, capable. .²2 Fit, proper, right. .{@-न्धः@} .²1 Connection, union, association. .²2 Relation, relationship. .²3 Relation, as the meaning of the genitive case. .²4 Matrimonial alliance; विक्रियायै न कल्पन्ते संबन्धाः सदनुष्ठिताः <ls>Ku. 6. 29</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 6.">30</ls>; जनकानां रधूणां च संबन्धः कस्य न प्रियः <ls>U. 1. 17</ls>. .²5 Friendly connection, friendship; संबन्धमाभाषणपूर्वमाहुः <ls>R. 2. 58</ls>. .²6 Fitness, propriety. .²7 Prosperity, success. .²8 A relation, kinsman. .²9 A collection, volume, book.
